title: Coty partners with Brandlight to boost beauty brand presence across AI search and discovery
summary: The Rimmel London and Marc Jacobs Beauty owner is ramping up its focus on artificial intelligence (AI), partnering with AI platform Brandlight to boost the presence of its beauty brands across AI assistants and generative AI search

extraction.key_fact: 코티가 AI 검색에서 자사 뷰티 브랜드의 노출을 높이려고 Brandlight와 손잡았다.
